profile_text.body:
IXL Learning operates IXL, which its site describes as a subscription-based learning site for K-12 covering math, language arts, science, social studies, and Spanish. The site says IXL is used by over 18 million students and offers personalized learning in more than 20,000 topics, with interactive questions, awards, and certificates intended to keep students motivated. The site also describes the product as offering a comprehensive K-12 curriculum, individualized guidance, and real-time analytics.

The company's tracked products also include Vocabulary.com, listed as adaptive vocabulary practice for students and teachers. Pricing for IXL has been reported at from $299/year for 25 students for a classroom license and from $9.95/month for family plans, though that pricing comes from a secondary source. Vocabulary.com district licenses are quoted individually, and one Florida district approved a 3-year contract for grades 7 to 12 not to exceed $226,127.

Both products are listed in the Education and Research AI category. The available material does not include verified student age ranges or privacy details for either product.
